name: fire_mage
notes: Fire: Scorch stacks Fire Vulnerability at the start of a long fight, Fireball is the filler, Fire Blast while the mage moves or when a mob is on it, Frost Nova on a mob in melee. A target that is immune to fire makes the server refuse Fireball; the brain backs the refused spell off for 5 s and Frostbolt, the last entry, takes over until the back-off ends (the donor falls back to Frostbolt on a fire-immune target the same way). Not checked live.
sources: mod-playerbots 79bd428 src/Ai/Class/Mage/Strategy/FireMageStrategy.cpp (default actions: Fireball, Frostbolt on a fire-immune target, Fire Blast while moving; Scorch to the Improved Scorch stacks)
